decision_conditions: <p>The cycle stores hereby approved shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted and shall be retained thereafter.</p>
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: BR01; BS 5837:2012 Tree Survey, Updated Arboricultural Impact Assessment, Method Statement & Tree Protection Plan; EBP; E01; E02; E03; E04; E05; Form 4 – Reasonable Exemption Statement; PBP; PBP (Proposed Flood Compensation Area); Planning Statement; P01; P02; P03; P04; P05; P06; P07; P08; SLP01; 41 Uxbridge Road, Stanmore. London. HA7 3LH– Flood Risk Assessment Rev 1.

<p>No site works or development shall commence until details of the levels of the building(s), road(s) and footpath(s) in relation to the adjoining land and highway(s), and any other changes proposed in the levels of the site, have been submitted to, and approved by, the local planning authority.</p>

<p>Prior to the commencement of works, a Construction Logistics Plan shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Statement shall include, but shall not be limited to:</p><p><br></p><p>i. the parking of vehicles of site operatives and visitors&nbsp;</p><p>ii. loading and unloading of plant and materials&nbsp;</p><p>iii. storage of plant and materials used in constructing the development&nbsp;</p><p>iv. measures to control the emission of dust and dirt during construction&nbsp;</p><p>v. a scheme for recycling/disposing of waste resulting from demolition and construction works</p><p><br></p><p>The demolition and construction of the building on site shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Method Statement.</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the approved plans and prior to the commencement of works (other than demolition works), a scheme of hard and soft landscape works for the site submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.</p><p>Soft landscape works shall include:&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>a.&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;a scheme of hard and soft landscape works which shall include a survey of all existing trees and hedgerows on the land, indicating those to be retained and those to be lost.</p><p>b.&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Landscape master plan,&nbsp;</p><p>c.&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;planting plans (at a scale not less than 1:100),&nbsp;</p><p>d.&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes, plant container sizes (all at time of planting) and proposed numbers / densities.</p><p>e.&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Written specification of planting and cultivation works to be undertaken</p><p>f.&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; A landscape implementation programme with proposed timing / dates for the works, including a period of 5 tears within the completion of the development for the replacement of soft landscaping</p><p><br></p><p>Hard landscape works shall include:</p><p>g.&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Details of boundary treatments (materials, scale of boundary, location),</p><p>h.&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Details of hard surfacing materials to be used in the landscaping of the site,&nbsp;</p><p>i.&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Written specification of planting and cultivation works to be undertaken.</p><p><br></p><p>The development shall be completed in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the approved plans and prior to the commencement of works hereby approved, full details of the permeable driveway (including finished level section drawings) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The permeable driveway hereby approved shall use a no dig/tree-friendly design.&nbsp;</p>
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

<p>Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby approved, details of the boundary treatment, including side gates between the dwellings and the site boundaries, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details approved shall be implemented and shall be retained thereafter.</p>

All planting, seeding or turfing comprised in the approved details of landscaping shall be carried out in the first planting and seeding seasons following the occupation of the building(s), or the completion of the development, whichever is the sooner.  Any existing or new trees or shrubs which, within a period of 5 years from the completion of the development, die, are removed, or become seriously damaged or diseased, shall be replaced in the next planting season, with others of a similar size and species, unless the local authority agrees any variation in writing.

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be constructed to the specifications of: "Part M, M4 (2), Category 2: Accessible and Adaptable Dwellings" of the Building Regulations 2013 and thereafter retained in that form.</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the approved plans and prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted, full details of bin stores (including the location) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The bin storage shall be made available prior to occupation and shall be retained thereafter. The refuse and waste bins shall be stored at all times, other than on collection days, within the designated refuse storage areas as shown on the approved details.</p>

<p>The window(s) and openings in the flank elevation(s) facing towards 43 Uxbridge Road of the proposed development shall:&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>(a) be of purpose-made obscure glass,&nbsp;</p><p>(b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level, and shall thereafter be retained in that form.</p>

<p>Prior to the first occupation of the development, evidence of Secured by Design Certification shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority in writing to be agreed, or justification shall be submitted where the accreditation requirements cannot be met. Secure by design measures shall be implemented the development shall be retained in accordance with the approved details.</p>

<p>Prior to the commencement of the development hereby approved other than demolition works, a Fire Safety Statement shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, this statement shall include details of how the development will function in terms of the following:</p><p><br></p><p>1) identify suitably positioned unobstructed outside space: a) for fire appliances to be positioned on b) appropriate for use as an evacuation assembly point&nbsp;</p><p>2) is designed to incorporate appropriate features which reduce the risk to life and the risk of serious injury in the event of a fire; including appropriate fire alarm systems and passive and active fire safety measures&nbsp;</p><p>3) is constructed in an appropriate way to minimise the risk of fire spread&nbsp;</p><p>4) provide suitable and convenient means of escape, and associated evacuation strategy for all building users&nbsp;</p><p>5) develop a robust management strategy for evacuation which is to be periodically updated and published (details of how often this management strategy is to be reviewed and published to be included), and which all building users can have confidence in</p><p>6) provide suitable access and equipment for firefighting which is appropriate for the size and use of the development.</p><p><br></p><p>The development shall be operated in accordance with the approved details in perpetuity.</p>

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England)  Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no development which would otherwise fall within Classes A, AA, B, D, E and F in Part 1 of Schedule 2 to that Order shall be carried out without the prior written permission of the local planning authority.

<p>Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby approved, a Car Parking Design and Management Plan shall be submitted to, and agreed in writing by, the Local Planning Authority. The plan shall set out the following:</p><p><br></p><p>a. Details of general spaces that are to be 'active' electric vehicle charging point spaces and are to be 'passive' electric vehicle charging point spaces.&nbsp; The plan should outline the provision of one active Electric Vehicle Charging Point for at least 20% of spaces from the outset with the remaining 80% passive and the mechanism for converting passive provision to active should demand increase.</p><p>b. Details of Disabled persons parking spaces in accordance with the levels set out in Table 10.6 of the London Plan 2021. The plan should outline the mechanism for converting standard spaces to disabled parking should demand increase.</p><p>c. Mechanism for increasing the number of general spaces that have an 'active' electric vehicle charging point if monitoring demonstrates additional demand.&nbsp;</p><p>d. Details of the allocation and management of the general and accessible car parking spaces.</p><p>e. Details of how the car parking spaces could be removed in the future should they become surplus to requirements and potentially be re-provided as cycle storage or landscaping.</p><p>f. Details of monitoring, management and enforcement procedures for parking within the site.</p>
description: Conversion of dwelling into two dwellings (1 X 2 bed and 1 X 5 bed); single and two storey front extension; single storey rear extension; rear dormer; installation of four rooflights in front roofslope; landscaping; bin and cycle stores; external alterations
